item.title: Ardezax
item.description:
Home continent of Dryz and Jaden

Cultural facts : Ardezax is under the governance of King Aldric Stormborn. There are different organized groups in Ardezax : The Artisan’s guild : mainly managed by the smaller folks, the crafters and the gatherers. The dwarves, the gnomes and the halflings work together to manage this guild. A proud coalition of crafters, thinkers, gatherers and traders. The Artisan’s guild is the economic backbone of Ardezax. Built on mutual profit and shared labor, they have pooled their talents to dominate the market on creation, logistics and creative acquisitions. It is used by many for contracts to craft, gather resources, enchant and sometimes to guard merchant roads especially when their goods are involved. The Halflings will also be willing to do other kinds of work, if you are discreet and willing to pay well. They take side jobs (or black market contracts) where theft can be involved from time to time where they will call it instead “borrowing”, even though they don’t intend to bring back the things stolen. Their headquarters, The Hands of Coin and Craft, is in Drusburgh, one of the main cities where merchants come in to eventually get to Bruxar. They hold an unofficial control over docks, loading and export pricing in Drusburgh and Caldaren. The different ranks in the guild are as follow : apprentice (learning the trades, mostly gatherers), journeyman (handle the basic contracts while still perfectioning their methods), master artisan (proven creators and experienced merchants), the Guildtable (council of veteran master artisans who vote on trade alliances, high contracts and political implications), The Coinwright (guildmaster who oversees the treasury and is the principal negotiator between the guild and the different cities of Ardezax. The present Coinwright is Brynna Coppervein, a third generation metalsmith and a ledger-mancer (magical accountant). She climbed the ranks not by brute force but by outsmarting her rivals and stabilizing guild finances. There is a clear pact between the Artisan’s guild and the Iron Accord for mutual protection and production contracts. Emblem (brass colored) : A hammer, a quill and a sickle arranged in a circle surrounded by a gear-shaped border with a flame in the center.
The Gilded Fangs : mainly managed by the less trusted races : goblins, hobgoblins, bugbears, orcs and kobolds. They are opportunistic muscle-for-hire with a focus on intimidation, coercion and “enforcement” rather than crime. They aren’t stealthy like the Underbelly, but they aren’t savages either. They are disciplined enough to be useful. The types of job they tend to prefer are debt collecting, blackmailing, “hostile negotiations”, sabotage, smash and grab raids or transport missions with questionable objects or individuals. Their headquarters, the Scrapclaw Hold, is located in Caldaren, being to the north of the country and having less inquisitions than the other cities of Ardezax. Their ranks are as follows : Recruits, Fangsmen (can lead small missions), Goldlords (take care of the necessary bribing of the guards and political manipulation), The Maw (guild leader). To become The Maw, one must win a blood duel. The current Maw is Thargoz the Reforged, a hob-goblin veteran who was left for dead by the Iron Accord and returned with a steel jaw. The Gilded Fangs code is Fangs First; No coin, no cause; and The strong lead. Emblem : A golden serpent coiled around a coin with a ruby studded fang piercing through the coin. The serpent represents cunning, greed and danger; the coin shows ambition to rule through wealth and their ruthless pursuit of gold; and the ruby evokes wealth and blood, suggesting that riches are paid for in violence.The Iron Accord : their composition is truly diverse : humans, half-elves, elves, tieflings, dragonborns, dwarves, tabaxi, etc. All that matters in the Iron Accord is skill. They are a professional mercenary organization, transparent and honorable to their contracts while being efficient. They offer military support for city-states or factions, they offer guards and escort missions, bounty hunting and monster hunting, they truly are a neutral force for peacekeeping. The guild is structured with ranks : Oathbrands (members), Pactwardens (officers), Commandant and The Iron Voice (guildmaster)). The current Iron voice is Marshal Caelan Virellian, a human, former battlefield commander who believes in order, honor and contracts. He isn’t naïve, he knows that ideals don’t win wars but that discipline and leverage do. He now carries a war ledger instead of a sword, leaving the fighting to the new generations and he has a steel coin on his desk reminding him that every decision has two faces. They work with mission delegations and they have their own arbitration council to prevent double-dealings, betrayals of contracts, no targeting civilians and the assurance of being paid. Their headquarters is called Hammerpost in Bruxar. Along their walls, there are plaques to honor their fallen. Emblem (steel gray coloured) : A towering shield crossed by two iron gauntlets. The shield represents protection, contract enforcement and the gauntlets represent discipline, strength and unity.The Crown’s guards : The main militia force of the continent. They make up the guards of every city and manage the dungeons.The Underbelly : They keep mostly to themselves and their “guild” is an association only spoken of in rumors. The rumors say that they are a guild meant for the darker jobs or jobs related to the Underdark, assassination, kidnapping, extortion, torture, theft being the lighter part of their activities.

item.title: Elvarel Nythorne's journal
item.description:
Entry I – Early Observations “…too many vanishings in Drusburgh. The Crown’s Guard pretends it is coincidence, but there is a rhythm. A silencing. It is as though whole families were… edited. Someone—or something—wants the city to forget.
Entry III – Whispers of the Past Beneath Caldaren lies something far older. Buried halls of Netheril, a cradle of magic shattered by hubris. Most deny it exists. The glyphs clawed at my mind. Someone is using that power again.”
Entry VI – The Name That Burns “In my study of Netheril’s collapse, one name cuts through all others—Karsus. The Arcanist who thought himself greater than gods, who reached into Mystra’s domain and shattered the Weave itself. His folly drowned empires and left only ruins in its wake.
Entry VII – Final Note (the last legible entry) “There is another song in Drusburgh. Louder than the waves, older than the stones. It eats memory, yes—but why here? Why now? Could it be… a distraction? Keeping eyes blind while the true work continues in Caldaren?” (The ink trails here, as though the pen fell.)

Lisandra Valora is the head priestess of the temple, Eldil heads to see her and have an audience with her. he discusses the disappearances, she mentions Darius Veynar was looking into it. she mentions a cleric that came in looking for someone, nobody knew who he was talking about, otherwise there's no other issues.
Dryz asks the priestess about the innkeepers husband and she remembers him, she only fairly rarely leaves the temple. The party asks the priestess to take care of Koreck and keep him on hallowed grounds to keep him safe. Jaden tells the kid to remain on the temple grounds and has a nice heart to heart.
Jaden gets looked at by a priest called Nyx, he can't get rid of Jaden's mark with a remove curse but it fails.
Jaden tell's us the hag is in the forest outside of Oakhurst.
Grimgil tries to talk to a bird about the surrounding forests. it says there is nothing off about the woods around here, they stay away from Drusburgh most of the time. they are rumours of birds never coming back from there.
The party encounters a lady selling carpets in the city, the carpets are all of the same person, but she does not know who it is "eyes in the earth" she says.
The party encounters a crew from the ship and they are looking for the quartermaster from the ship, Bow does not remember her, Dryz tries to tell her to leave Drusburgh, but it's not very convincing. Tessa went to the market to get food and supplies. Sticks and Stone, Water to Wine and Born in bread.
The party tries to retrace her steps to see what happened to her. she placed an order at the sticks and stones to be delivered to the valiant ember. Jaden steals a mirror. Eldil has to pay a high price for a mirror and a vendor is very hesitant to part with it. the party heads to the Water to Wine.

I don’t trust myself much longer. Writing it may be the only way it survives. Something is wrong in Drusburgh. I’ve lost track of the days, of the people… there are faces I know I should remember, but when I try, it’s as if the names dissolve on my tongue. Whole families gone, and no one speaks of it. When I ask, they stare at me like I’m mad—or worse, they pity me. And the singing… gods, the singing. At first faint, like a lullaby behind the walls, then stronger, as if the stones themselves hum with it. When it comes, my thoughts are no longer mine. Hours slip away. When the silence returns, something is missing. Always something. I fear I’m next. If I vanish, don’t let them call it sickness, or a sailor lost at sea. Search beneath the city, beneath the boards and the stones. Something feeds there, I swear it. If you still remember me after I’m gone, then follow the song. If you don’t… burn this letter, and may the gods preserve your mind. — Tessa

There are leftover bones and remains in the sewers some humanoid some animals, they sometimes matches some of the potholes and damage. Eldil tries to taunt the hag, noises of fingers scratching on a chalkboard appear. they hag talks to Eldil and offers a bargain.
The party ends up in an open space with more corpses and looks like a nest, Grimgil casts alarm to attempt to catch. Dryz notices there are no live animals in the sewers. The party heads to bed, Jaden remembers there are conditions to killing a hag, he is not sure what those are but it's not as straight forward as just killing it.
Eldil is on first watch, he hears water drips and smells a swamp even though there's no rain outside. he believes it's the hag, there's a long black hair. "now, now deary, don't be hasty. I overheard a few things earlier, looking for someone, I might know a few things for a price, hmm family related who knows" Eldil responds that he is looking for someone. "Well we wouldn't want to wake your friends, just step outside and perhaps we can have a trade". she offers to take some of eldil's blood for information on Manuil. Eldil chooses to step outside, but trips Grimgil's alarm, he tell the party is just going to pee, but Grimgil is suspicious. The hag keeps talking to Eldil "I'll give you a price, but first ask" Eldil says he wants transportation to Manuil. "Now.... that's it, the only information is that their new cults raising around and his name seems to be gaining in popularity, she's vague about his whereabouts". Eldil senses she is telling the truth and says the price is only a little blood. Eldil accepts, she extracts some of his blood from his neck.
Grimgil thinks this is taking a long time and reaches out to Eldil, he dismisses him, Grimgil looks for Eldil outside and starts to approach, The hag transports Eldil somewhere. Grimgil goes outside looking for Eldil and only finds the smell of salt. The party heads to bed determined to find Eldil in the morning. During Dryz's watch he hurls insults and threats at the hag through the mirror. She responds "This is what you asked for, eat us". Dryz's panicked at losing someone else, eats all six tadpoles trying to harness their power to get to eldil, but nothing happens yet.
Jaden has a dream of a figure, he knows it is a mimicry of something that doesn't understand nature, "The beast obey you" a bunch of weird animals appear. "We offer you true tongue of the wild". the druid touches his chest: "Take root .... I am groot". it's tadpole related. he wakes up and and there is the smell of wet moss, and has dirty fingernails. he gains a new power.
During Grimgil's watch, he notices the mirror that Dryz was using, he gets up to place a piece of cloth and see's himself looking back at him, the reflection grows and fills the mirror. Grim looks away. and see's the hag in a window, see's her long fingers grabbing Koreck in the temple, Grim tries to attack her, but suddenly gets up from back in his bedroll. The hag is gone. the mirror is no longer there. it was all in his head. Grim covers all sources of reflection he can.
During Jaden's watch, Dryz dreams, he is in a blinding white cathedral floating above a tower of obsidian glass. the sky cracks sending a storm of tentacles made of starlight in void whispering truth and offer themselves to him, he accepts: "you are our favourite" it says, it's Dryz's voice, the magic is clean, a mirror rises, dryz see's himself smiling too wide, his mouth opens like a blooming flower, a tadpole comes out. there is something else watching, the tadpole wraps itself and fuses with dryz. glowing faintly Dryz's blood becomes cool and thick, each spell i've ever cast reverse itself, he feels a second brain behind, teling him he can change people against their will for their own good, he chooses to try and suppress it, he doesn't want to force this on others.
Jaden see's Dryz convulse and tries to wake him, Dryz succeeds in resisting against the tadpole and wakes up. Dryz goes back to sleep, Jaden and Grimgil discuss giving him nettie's potion.

item.title: Session 29
item.description:
The party quickly dispatched of most of the people trying to attack them. Grimgil uses a wild shape to change into a burrowing animal and make a grave for the thieves. Bow takes a moment to regret his swift killing of these desperate people.
The party continues their travels, Jaden and Dryz discuss the vial incident. Grimgil identifies the vial as Wyvern poison, The party continues on their journey to find the hags lair.
The party travels for a few days and get to the woods outside where the hags lair is, there are no signs or indication as to where to go, people who make deals with the hag forget where she lives. Eldil seems to know to enter the woods.
Grimgil tries to speak to a bird to get information on the hags location. the bird has no idea where it might be, but Eldil has a vibe of where he needs to go.
The party have to leave the horses behind as the forest get thicker. as they get deeper the trees start to part and get less dense. Grimgil casts locate creature on Old Mother Salt, he doesn't sense anything yet. The party continues at Eldil's guidance.
The further the party goes into the forest, they notice a distinct lack of birds, Jaden doesn't like the woods. they encounter some small streams, when he was young and Jaden escaped, he escaped from a children's room, into a dining room and a corridor leading to the exterior. Jaden doesn't exactly remember the landscape, it smelled of salt mixed with other foul smell. the terrain was difficult to navigate, he eventually did the revers of the parties trip to outside of the forest.
The party finally arrives to a clearing, Grimgil casts detect magic, and feels illusion magic all around, Dryz tries to invetigate and shatters the illusion, the clearing is actually gross and not green, Dryz informs the party of this and Eldil casts dispel magic on the illusion, but it fails. Jaden manages to see through the illusion. he recognizes the smell.
The party continues onwards in the illusion, the party encounters creatures, they look like sheep under the illusion. Dryz tries to warn Grimgil that it's a beast, but it attacks him. Roll for initiative.
The party manages to dispatch of the the sheep / werewolves, they bandage a few wounds and continue on their way to the hag, walking in water they see a nice cabin / a weird gnarly sunken wooden house.
They need to cross a 40 ft river, Jaden uses fly to carry the party across but they get attacked by a flower before Dryz can be carried accross. Roll for initiative.
The party defeats a swamp creature and approach the hag's hut. Edlil, Grim and Jaden cast protection against good and evil on themselves.
As the party gets near the hut, the door opens with a creak. an old lady exits the hut and addresses the party, thanks them for bringing Jaden and asks the rest of the party what they need, she mentions that we helped her with the false hydra, and offer to make a deal for us to defeat manuil and Karsus to prevent him from coming back and killing Mystra.
The hag modifies the memory of the party except for Grimgil to make them think that leaving Jaden with her is not a bad idea.
Jaden and Grimgil argues with the rest of the party convincing them that they've been deceived, they move in to the hut, Jaden see's the spirit of a small boy wayving at him, Jaden recongnizes him as Toby (The kid the hag made him eat).
The small of salt is strong inside the dimly lit hut, it is a like a tree trunk twisting down into the ground, after about 10 ft in the hut Eldil and Jaden stop.
Eldil finds himself in a chamber from his childhood home, it's candlelit and Manuil is also there, he has a book of magic. "one day brother we'll be more than this, we'll have enough power to make the world bend" he says, and offer the book to Eldil. Eldil refuses the book, glyphs on the book animate and enter Manuil's body and his eyes start to burn with netherese fire. The room crumbles into the location Eldil saw in the vision presented by the Hag.
Jaden finds himself in a dining hall from his childhood home, his parents are there raising a toast to Jaden (Tyll). everything is perfect, a sibling of Jaden tells him to show everyone what he can do. Jaden hesitates and doesn't want to show his family what he can do, his sibling keeps pushing. His siblings turns against him, and call him a monster.
Grimgil finds himself in the smocky cavern of his clans den, Goblin children are laughing and cheering as they bully Grimgil, his parents watch dissapointed, telling him he doesn't belong and to leave, the cavern crumbles as jeers echo louder.
Dryz finds himself in a dimly lit cavern, with faint light on the walls, Elir calls out, they are hanging out. Elir asks "We will watch each others backs forever won't we?" Dryz agrees, but suddenly he turns white and screeches, disappearing.
Timmthiel finds himself in a small familiar cottage, with Therian Blackwood, his dad, he sits by the fire. "We're safe here boy, no one will ever hurt you" he says. Shadows appear and crawl across the floor. "you were never safe, you were never wanted" he now says. the door opens with a cold wind, and the king enters and points at Bow "Bastard, Mistake, Hidden thing you should never had drawn breath"

item.title: Session 28
item.description:
Flash back to when Eldil was teleported by the hag to Manuil's last known location.
Eldil appears in a darkly lit room and hears Manuil talking to someone: "This is it, this is how we get in, this is how we accomplish our mission." He also mention's Karsus.
Eldil approaches and says "probably weren't expecting me now brother." Eldil falls on his face, the hag laughs and an illusion fades away. It was a hag trick,
The area is muddy, swampy and stinks, sounds of children's whispers. it is underground. there are three corridors leading outside of the large room he is in. The hag offers to teleport him back for a cost or just leave him there. Eldil tries to cast bane on the hag but it fails. He tries to attack her with his weapon instead. The pact that Eldil made with the Hag makes it so he can't attack her.
Eldil agrees to bring Jaden to the Hag in order for her to return him to the party. if he fails his soul is forfeit.
Eldil appears back at the ass place in the morning, to the surprise of the rest of party. Eldil tells the party that he made a deal with the Hag and has her mark now and that she wants Jaden in exchange for Eldil's soul.
Jaden still struggles with the idea of poisoning Dryz,
Jaden gives an impassioned speech to the party, saying he admires the rest of the party, he admits he is a shape changer and steals peoples identities and lives as them, he tried to do good but he realizes it's not enough and offers to take Netties poison.
The Hag chimes in and tells us she wants Jaden and he's been lying to us. the party doesn't care and tells Jaden he is a welcome member of the party.
Eldil describes the location he was teleported to, Jaden remembers a swamp which might be where Eldil was taken.
The party heads to the Iron accord archives to try and find information on how to kill a hag. They find Thomas Aquinous who works for the Iron accord. Thomas tells them they have a book fromBaldur’s Gate that has to do with Hags, it's called Hansel and Gretel and is kind of like the Jeremy Renner movie "Hansel and Gretel: Witch Hunters".
In the book, they had to take an Anathema which is the Hag's most hated thing and use it in a ritual before killing the hag. the ritual makes the Hag mortal for a period of time. The ritual needs to be completed by a ritual caster. Requires a ritual circle drawn with resources that have an affinity to the Hag with the anathema held in the center.
Thomas gathers the party's testimony so he can have the Iron accord investigate a Hag being on Ardezax.
Eldil asks why Bow is wanted, he says he doesn't know slightly deceptively, Eldil casts hold person, Grimgil takes his letter and demands Bow shares his secrets. insulted Bow refuses to share.
The party heads to see Darius Veynar and have him teleport us to Bruxar. he gives us a letter to give once we arrive to Bruxar, it is to inform that we are carrying horses to the King's guard. Bow and Grimgil transform into horses so they don't look out of place. Once teleported they hand the letter to the guard, they let them pass. The party is now in Bruxar. Jaden leads the rest of the part around Bruxar. they drop off they're extra horse to the Crown's guard.
Dryz approaches a guard and tries to bring up the Hag subtly to see if they have any reaction while having detect thoughts active, but they don't at all.
The party heads shopping to get some clothes and disguises for Bow and Grimgil, Jaden changes his appearances. They then head to a library.
In the library they look to do more research, but get turned away. and head to Bruxar's chapter of the Gilded Fangs.
As they are heading to the Gilded Fang's Old mother Salt shows Eldil a quick map of where to find her, between Springvale and Oakhurst.
As they are heading to a different section of the city, a guard recognized Bow and stops the party. Dryz uses a subtle suggestion to have the guard let them pass and they are allowed through.
Because Bow is wanted Grimgil stays with him at an inn away from the Gilded Fang's. the rest of the party go to the Gilded Fang. Dryz enters and talks to an Orc, Jaden activates his detect thoughts, while Dryz describes the Hag in Detail. they don't find any more details on the Hag's weakness.
The party decides to head towards the Hag's lair and set's up camp a little bit outside of town.
During his watch, Grimgil notices the poors trying to attack the party roll for initiative.

The Gilded Fangs code is Fangs First; No coin, no cause; and The strong lead. Emblem : A golden serpent coiled around a coin with a ruby studded fang piercing through the coin. The serpent represents cunning, greed and danger; the coin shows ambition to rule through wealth and their ruthless pursuit of gold; and the ruby evokes wealth and blood, suggesting that riches are paid for in violence.

item.title: Iron accord
item.description: The Iron Accord : their composition is truly diverse : humans, half-elves, elves, tieflings, dragonborns, dwarves, tabaxi, etc. All that matters in the Iron Accord is skill. They are a professional mercenary organization, transparent and honorable to their contracts while being efficient. They offer military support for city-states or factions, they offer guards and escort missions, bounty hunting and monster hunting, they truly are a neutral force for peacekeeping. The guild is structured with ranks : Oathbrands (members), Pactwardens (officers), Commandant and The Iron Voice (guildmaster)). The current Iron voice is Marshal Caelan Virellian, a human, former battlefield commander who believes in order, honor and contracts. He isn’t naïve, he knows that ideals don’t win wars but that discipline and leverage do. He now carries a war ledger instead of a sword, leaving the fighting to the new generations and he has a steel coin on his desk reminding him that every decision has two faces. They work with mission delegations and they have their own arbitration council to prevent double-dealings, betrayals of contracts, no targeting civilians and the assurance of being paid. Their headquarters is called Hammerpost in Bruxar. Along their walls, there are plaques to honor their fallen. Emblem (steel gray coloured) : A towering shield crossed by two iron gauntlets. The shield represents protection, contract enforcement and the gauntlets represent discipline, strength and unity.

item.description:
The party is at the inn in Frila ready for a long rest, Bow uses his fish staff to make a performance in the inn's aquarium, they have to wait until morning for Halsin to restore the mayors soul. Grimgil uses speak with animal and convinces the fishes to perform "under the see" from the little mermaid.

The party tries all sorts of remedies to cure Eldil, but none of them work.
Jaden exits the inn and goes for a stroll, Grimgil attunes to his stick, now called the everburning club of embers.

The party wakes up without any other incident. they exit the inn and head over to the infirmary to wait for Halsin , but he is already there. they give him the soul stone and Halsin starts a ritual to restore the mayor's soul to his body, at the same time Grimgil ritually heals people in the infirmary. Halsin's ritual succeeds and the soul stone is destroyed. Nilas Orelian wakes up disoriented, but seems fine. the party leaves the mayor alone to discuss with vallen thorn. Halsin says goodbye and mentions that people will be waiting to talk to us at the harbour. the party heads out of town towards Black tide bay.
During the journey Grimgil casts aid and waterbreathing on the party, as they arrive, Eldil approaches people dismantling fortifications and asks who is in charge. Merrick thorn answers, and Eldil gives him the letter from Vallen thorn. He offers us a ride on the Valient Amber, his own ship, on route to Drusburgh, a city on Ardezax.

Gale says he's been studying the tadpole problem, he's teleported to many places even outside of the island, and the tadpole problem is everywhere, he seems to believe they might all transform as a single event. Gale warns the party to be carful when they head to ardezax.

The port workers ready the ship and the party heads out on the ship to Ardezax on a week long journey.
The party has discussion on the ship, Dryz reveals most of his backstory, omitting the true scale of the conspiracy he uncovered, they then discuss the plan once they get to Drusburgh. Eldil wants to move on immidiately to get to Baldur's Gate, he explains he wants to kill Manual, all he says he desrves it, he elaborates later. Manual is an old friend, they were basically brothers, Manual betrayed Eldil and his family.
Eldil, admits that Manual killed his parents, he explodes in a rage a triggers his radiant consumption accidentally

Eldil stands barefoot on alien stone, it is warm thick and alive and throbbing. like the nautiloid ship. He can't move at all, his fingers lack fingernails his skin is grey. he tries to scream but fails. there is something slithering behind his teeth. he sees many figures from his past, they start to blur and morph into mind flayers. One speaks in his mind "You were never one of them, always one of us". He retches and pukes up bile, he goes through ceremorphosis and loses all his memories and they are replaced by mind flayer thoughts, he feels the call of the elder brain. item.title: Session 17
item.description:
The party is at the gates of Frila, the guards tells the party they should talk to Vallen Thorn to get information on the necromancer. The party heads towards city hall to talk to the investigators, the city looks destroyed, most homes are in disrepair, some are boarded up.
Grimgil speaks to one of the villagers (a lady with a beard because of the mist) she inform him that anytime after dusk and before down there is danger, people are going missing some coming back as zombies. It all started after goblins attacked the city. PS its canon that goblins have boobs
The area closer to city hall is less destroyed and better guarded. Eldil uses Divine sense outside of the town hall but finds nothing, the party enters the town hall and Eldil uses divine sense again. he senses something undead behind him and turns around, he sees an elf at the bottom of the stairs that appears undead.
Grimgil and Bow notice that the undead elf has a tadpole in his head. Eldil approaches him and attempts to grapple him, he succeeds and the elf calls for help, guards are starting to approach, Eldil starts attacking him. Roll for imitative.
Dryz suggests to the Elf that he reveals his true nature and surrenders to the guards, he tells the guards he is Astarion, an Elf from Baldur's Gate, they arrest Eldil because he attacked the elf, Eldil continues to try and escape and reveal his undeadness. chaos ensues.
Bow talks in the head of Astarion, he believes the party are assassins sent by Cazador, the party informs him this is not the case.
In the end, Eldil is dragged to the jail, Grimgil escaped as a horse, Jaden, Bow and Dryz follow willingly to the jail, they wait for Vallen Thorn to discuss what happened. Vallen Thorn does not Believe Eldil, informs the party that Astarion has been helping them for the few weeks. Bow asks him about the other problems in town, but he is unwilling to share any details after the ordeal. Eldil needs to stay in the cell for the night.
Vallen Thorn tells us that Malkavor Ardin is the necromancer we are looking for. Dryz asks to stay the night so he can keep an eye on Eldil. Vallen Thorn explains that nobody has return when investigating the town crypt, every time people leave town they don't return.
Jaden and Bow, spend the rest of the day investigating in the town, Grimgil finds bum circles to gather information, there was another attack last night so there shouldn't be any attacks for a few days.
During the night Dryz notices a shadow in the jail, but it leaves as soon as he makes a sound, Bow gets sneakily grappled by Astarion and he starts interrogating Bow about why they attacked them. Astarion asks if the party came from the ship, he explains that he was also from the ship, he ran straight to Frila. Bow compares Astarion to Eldil, Astarion says he has a gift for him. Astarion has been Cazador's prisoner for a while. he was freed since he has had the tadpole implanted in him on the ship.
In the morning, Vallen Thorn comes and sets Dryz and Eldil free, Halsin came by to have a chat with with the party. Eldil finds the garnotte in his pack and drops them on the ground. The party talks to Halsin, he tells the party that Malkavor Ardin was just an ugly poor boy that couldn't get into a magic school, he had inate magic and demonstrated sociapathic tendencies, his mother was down with the sickness and the necromancer lost it and is holding the town accountable because they didn't help her at all. Vallen Thorn admitted that they intentionally didn't provide aid to him because they feared him. In his final hint, he revealed that the mayor souls was the last piece needed to unleash permanent death on frila.
While Eldil and Jaden are talking about Eldil's anger issues, Astarion drops in and asks him why he's been so aggro, Astarion explains that his undead stain is a curse, a curse he accepted while on death's door that turned him into a thrall for 1000 years. Eldil gives Jaden's his axe and tries to approach him, Astarion gives him a parting word "Do not accept help from Cazador". Astarion also offers to find a way off the island, Eldil seems excited about that prospect.
The party heads out of Frila to the Crypt, there are beings in the mists walking around they are zombies (possibly doing the thriller dance), the party tries to stealth past the zombies to get to the crypt, Eldil's armor clinks about. Roll for initative.
Nilas Orelian is the Mayor of Frila

item.title: Session 16
item.description:
The party attempts to escape the volcano on warhorses as it begins to erupt, while rushing out of through the maze rocks fall and knockout Eldil, Grimgil heals him and Dryz casts catnap and shoves him in the bag of holding. item.title: Tessa
item.description:
Quartermaster from the Valient Amber who went missing in Drusburgh and left a letter for the party,
I don’t trust myself much longer. Writing it may be the only way it survives. Something is wrong in Drusburgh. I’ve lost track of the days, of the people… there are faces I know I should remember, but when I try, it’s as if the names dissolve on my tongue. Whole families gone, and no one speaks of it. When I ask, they stare at me like I’m mad—or worse, they pity me. And the singing… gods, the singing. At first faint, like a lullaby behind the walls, then stronger, as if the stones themselves hum with it. When it comes, my thoughts are no longer mine. Hours slip away. When the silence returns, something is missing. Always something. I fear I’m next. If I vanish, don’t let them call it sickness, or a sailor lost at sea. Search beneath the city, beneath the boards and the stones. Something feeds there, I swear it. If you still remember me after I’m gone, then follow the song. If you don’t… burn this letter, and may the gods preserve your mind. — Tessa

item.title: Session 13
item.description:
The party was just released into the city after winning the games, but they cannot leave the city or they will be killed. Carved tunnel system in the mountain lead to different part of Trixie. The party heads to an old temple of Maglubiyet now dedicated to the Absolute to inquire more about Igarok. Going up to the temple their is a destroyed statue to Maglubiyet.
Jaden enters an alleyway and disguises himself as a hobgoblin, the party enters the temple Dryz carrying a wild shaped Grimgil in his hair, the Temple is desacrated and a bit messy with symbols of the absolute, the is a circular seating area, Dryz approaches an acolyte and asks about the plot to summon Igarok, his name is Glimmerfang the Wicked. He tells us they are sacrificing bodies in mount dalgan, also they are searching for some sort of rock that is required in mount dalgan to summon Igarok, Priestest Glut has chambers in the temple but spends most of her time in mount Dalgan. The three leaders of the absolute are Orin, Aldric Stormborn, and Ketheric Thorm. Aldric stormborn was the king of Ardezax
The party heads to the warty toad inn, to grab a room and let Halsin look them over. Halsin says that the tadpole is not normal and is surrounded by Nethereses magic, a type of forbidden magic that is not accessible to everybody. Mystra the goddess of all magic and the weave, she once had a battle with another entity which used netherese magic, Mystra forbids the use of netherese magic
Halsin suggest we investigate how netherese magic is involved he suggest the party continues to investigate the Absolute as the tadpole and the rise of the cult seem related.
Halsin tries to help Bow with his memory and finds out that his name use to be Thimithiel Blackwood. he grew up and had smithy on his farm where he grew up and was proficient with the bow and his father is Therian Blackwood he comes from the continent of Ardezax just like Dryz and Jaden. The party goes to sleep.
Grimgil has a weird dream, his tadpole talks to him. "YEsssss, you've been doing great for us, let us show you our power" and gets a new ability. In his dream he assumes a form of small goblin with tentacle visage.
Jaden dreams of an old temple with murals of harmonious fire and wind, he walks through the temple, a tall figure with a white beard raises his hands and images on the mural come to live. "Balance and Power Fire and Sky you are the bearer of our destiny" The image stops moving and Jaden hears a grunt of pain, the figure is a little different, "did it have tentacles all along" Jaden wakes up and feels fire on his left hand and a cool breeze on his right hand. the tadpole says "We can grant you power, you just have to bind these marks in your flesh"
The party heads back to the collosseum to see where the bodies are being taken out and brough to mount dalgan. Goblins are loading up carts with dead body getting ready to bring them to mount Dalgan.
Jaden uses pass without a trace on the party, Jaden uses disguise self to become a wounded goblin. Grimgil corpses up Dryz and Bow. Grimgil summons a bunch of small creatures and runs behind them yelling "Get them they got away" they both roll Nat20 deception checks and the goblins with the corpse pile immediately chase them down to try and capture them. during this time the party sneaks on to the corpse piles in the carts and hides within them.
After a while the Goblins come back and carry the carts outside of the city, the party waits a bit but Grimgil can't handle being in the bodies and becomes a rat to get out of the corpse pile and scouts. There are a few goblin guards, and about 10 units and 4 chauffeurs and 4 Triceratops pulling each wagon, they are probably not trained to fight.
The party waits for nightfall, but the convoy doesn't stop so they attack in the dark, and ultimately defeat the goblins.

item.title: Session 11

Jeaden had a dream. Eldil had a pleasant dream about his family love which turned into a nightmare.

item.description:
Before Falling asleep the tadpole tells Eldil to eat his most recently found tadpole, he choses not to. Eldil dreams of his childhood playing in the woods with his dad and brother, they have friendly sibling competition, in the distance his dad fades away and disappears, Eldil is frozen in his dreams, his mother also starts fading but Eldil's vison goes black and the tadpole promises him vengeance, "one of us, one of us".
Morning comes, Jaden is making tea, everyone has some cool leaf tea. Bow uses his trident to catch some fresh fish for breakfast, Grimgil gives everyone 2 goodberry. As the party is ready to leave Grimgil casts waterwalk on everyone and they cross the river.
The party continues to travel towards Trixie, on the second day of travelling the forest starts to look de-forested and bare, lots of burnt piles of wood. by the third day it becomes mostly ash and desert. Eldil practices some papa roach on the pan flute.

item.title: Session 10
item.description:
The Party is in front of the town hall after killing Minthara. Jaden heads to the Celadon Barracks, enters the window grabs a hook a rope and a flag of the absolute. Eldil writes the absolute is dead in the ground. The party heads to the sewers, Jaden looks for egg sized garnotte.

A goblin spotted the party leaving but seemed more concerned with what was happening inside the city. Grimgil takes control of the rat to investigate the celadon inner city, the source of the horn, the goblins found Minthara's dead body and are regrouping. Grumnack is talking to Rugsog, they discuss going back to Trixie and start heading to Trixie. Arcane eyes left the city first and the goblins followed them.
The Party discusses plans, settle on letting the Goblins filter out of Celadon and then liberating it and looking for information in the city. set up camp in the forest south of the city and rest for the rest of the day. Jaden makes tea, Eldil practices the Pan flute. Grimgil heads into the wilderness to find food, only finds a single bad mushroom and some water. Jaden gives Dryz his headband of Intellect.
Bow goes to the river, dominates a fish and kills it to brings it to camp to eat. The party starts a long rest, during Eldil and Grimgil's watch. Grimgil has a heart to heart with Eldil, possibly effective. Grimgil also asks about his darkness. Eldil only says "he has unfinished business to deal with". and doesn't share more than that. Jaden during his watch sneaks a garnotte in Eldil's bag.
The long rest is over the party is now level 7
Grimgil goes to forage again in the morning and prepares a root, goodberry and squirrel meal for everyone.
Grimgil creates a flying familiar to check out what is happening in Celadon, there is no goblin activity at all in the city. There are signs of battle and more dead goblins in the city. there are no Arcane eyes. The party heads towards Celadon.
At the city gate, it is locked. Eldil throws a grappling on top of the wall and climbs the wall to unlock the gate for the rest of the party.
The party heads straight to the town hall in the inner city, on the way notice plenty of dead goblin Grumnack is one of them. it seems like some of the goblins tried to free themselves from the absolute but it didn't go to well.
In front of the town hall Grimgil casts Detect magic, the party enters the townhall and looks for Maps and documents that might lead to baldur's gate. A map is found, longtooth island is south west, faerun is to the east and north east of longtooth is Ardezax? a bigger island (more details from DM to follow).
In the makeshift prisons the party finds 4 remain civilians, Bow free's them and offers them goodberries, Grimgil talks to one of them, during the same time Eldil casts prayer of healing on them. Theodore Kesington is the mayor of Celadon. one of the other survivors is his wife Evelyn Kisington. The party instructs the mayor to head back to the grove, inform them Celadon is free and safe and bring back the refugees.
Jaden raids the granary to make a large stew for the survivors, Eldil brings the civilians to the temple, Grimgil follows Theodore Kesington and his wife to his home, Grimgil gets a fancy bow.
At the temple (Temple of Selune, there is rubble blocking the crypt so Eldil and Grimgil start removing the rubble. Bow and Dryz start helping a little later. The mayor grabs a magical vial of blood from an office in the crypt and gives it to us and the leaves for the grove
The Party raids the rest of the crypt and finds 500GP of golden objects, 50 GP of diamonds and 50GP of other gems.
The party decides to make their way towards Trixie to rescue Halsin from the Gladiator games.
At a river crossing the Party sets up camp so Grimgil can prepare water walk. at nigth Grimgil tells the party about his childhood. (I was listening so the details are not written, Alex send me a summary if you have one). Jaden shares that he is from Ardezax, so is Dryz. Ardezax is familiar to Bow.
To help Bow find out more about himself, Grimgil uses detect thoughts and dives deeper into his psyche, but does not find any valuable information. He thinks his name is not Bow, but before he met us a tiefling kept calling him Bow.
Dryzfrin is from Misthaven, Jaden grew up Caldaren, Eldil is from western Faerun.
One of the people we rescued (Benjamin) from the approaches us in the middle of the night, tells us he is not feeling well, he stayed in Celadon, he collapses and tentacles sprout from him, Roll for Initiative! Combat Play-by-Play:
Eldil activates his radiant consumption
The tentacle monster opens a portal and hits everyone but Eldil for large amount of damage.
Jaden gets up applies hunter's mark to benjamin, shoots and hit him twice.
Eldil attacks the benjamin twice and hits once.
Bow gets up uses second wind, then shoots the alligators twice and hits once, bloodying it.
The alligators dash to grimgil and Dryz
Dryz uses mind sliver twice on benjamin, forces a legendary resistance use for one, the other fails even with silvery barbs from Dryz and Grimgil.
Grimgil summons his fire spirit and moves behind bow to get cover
Benjamin moves towards Dryz, Eldil hits with an opportunity attack. uses lightning bolt on dryz, bow and grimgil. all three save and take half damage
Jaden shoots benjamin with 4 attack the first attack causes benjamin to teleport away, the 3 other attacks hit including 2 crits and benjamin is now bloodied.
Eldil bardic inspires Dryz, then attacks Benjamin and hits twice killing him.
Bow uses fighting spirit and action surge then shoots at the alligators 4 times hitting 4 times, killing one of them and bloodying the other.
The last alligator attacks Bow twice, hitting twice, after Grimgil turns a crit to a hit using silvery barbs.

item.title: Session 10
item.description:
Jaden quickly looted a few things from the barracks (rope and a grappling hook and he took a flag hanging outside) They then left to go rest in the first outside of town again When they got to the sewer exit, they heard a horn sounding from the inner village During that evening Grimgil and Eldil had a heart to heart moment of bonding. Signs of a struggle happened while the goblins were leaving the town.
Players understood that with the current head of the Absolute cut off, some goblins tried to revolt. Players make their way inside Celadon to find maps and documents. They head to the Town Hall and find a world map and 4 remaining prisoners unconscious. After healing the prisoners, they got some info from the mayor of Celadon, M. Theodore Kesington. The other prisoners were his wife Evelyn Kesington, and 2 other residents of Celadon, Benjamin Caldwell and another young man whom Theodore forgot his name. Jaden made a big soup in front of the Temple while Theodore went to fetch his last remaining magic items that were hidden in the nobles quarters and the Temple (a +1 longbow and +1 Bloodwell vial). The players then left the 4 civilians telling them to go to Sylvanus Grove and bring back the other civilians. Informing them also that the goblin threat is lifted for now. With the world map, players found out every known location of Toril. They also found that they were on an island called Longtooth Island which is located southwest of Ardezax. Ardezax being another bigger island off the coast of Faerûn. The players then left to head towards Trixie, marching out of Celadon through the north and choosing to cross the river towards mount Dalgan. After a really good bonding moment with all the players, telling each other where they are from, they decided to turn in the night. During Eldil’s watch, the 1st watch, they had lit 4 fires and Eldil was playing the flute making it easy for them to be found by Benjamin Caldwell.
Benjamin made his way to Eldil, not feeling well. Falling before him, he started transforming into a mind flayer, the ceremorphosis being complete. Players then fought a mind flayer who tried to convince/recruit Eldil since he had made such good progress with the Absolute. During the encounter, players saw what the mind flayers power was capable of and saw two-headed crocodiles with small tentacles sprouting from their bodies come out of the river. After they proceeded to kill the mindflayer and the crocodiles. Eldil then proceeded to collect another tadpole. This is where the session ended.

Players looted the ogres. They had a long rest.

After deceiving their way inside pretending to be a dead goblin from the “ambush team”, they were met with a squadron of goblins and a hobgoblin who wanted to interrogate Jaden who was a goblin supposedly dead.
Being led by 6 goblins and Dror Ragzlin, the hobgoblin, inside the inner city and taken into the nearest building inside for interrogation, Grimgil decided to step out and try to run inside a corner of the house. Being spotted as a hand sized spider, the goblins squashed him and discovered Grimgil. Grimgil then fled into the sewer system of the city as a rat, but remained nearby. Jaden then tried to deceive the goblins again by trying to run outside to “help” them catch Grimgil and by doing so evaded a grapple of Dror. He then immediately made a rope trick 3 feet from the ground and hid in it.
While this was happening, Dryzfrin and Bow tried to follow the players whilst staying in nearby alleyways. Their scent being picked up by wargs, they hid in the sewer system of the city. Trying to make their way through the sewer system all the way to the inner city until they learned of Grimgil’s misfortune and Jaden’s sudden disappearance from the telepathic connection they had, Dryzfrin stepped into action. Teleporting himself on top of the inner city wall and jumping down trying to help his friend. He got caught alone and, while unconscious, got dragged to the inner city’s prison. Finally, Bow, trying to catch up to Dryzfrin, made the jump on top of the inner city’s wall. Jumped down still invisible, got tangled inside a wild growth spell that Grimgil did to try and help limit the enemies movement. Bow’s scent got picked up by the 2 wards on the inside of the inner wall, and he’s now fighting for his life.
Lastly, Jaden finally popped his head out of his rope trick to communicate with his friends. He’s now hiding in the nearby thick grass caused by the wild growth spell.

Players hear from the tadpole in their head that they need to get to the cockpit and activate the realm jump function of the ship.
They also had the opportunity to free an intellect devourer from a corpse. Grimgil ate it? Aeson drank a random blue potion and became blind.
While players are making their way, they fought a dragon that was badly injured and chained to the deck of the nautiloid
Grimgil got hit by an intellect devourer ability that reduced his intelligence to 0. Players solved a riddle to create a potion for Grimgil restoring his intelligence.
After that, players made their way to the cabin and found a mind flayer fighting with a cambion named Commander Zhalk. They made it to realm jump, and activated it.
After the realm jump, the ship was so damaged that it crashed on an island. The players were thrown off the ship and fell with debris. When they were about to hit the ground, they started slowing down and levitating before being laid on the beach.
Next session, players get woken up by Eldil. They find an artifact lying on the ground. They made their way through the nautiloid ship and helped 4 intellect devourers in a teleportation circle made specifically for them.
After that they heard cries of help. When rushing to the aid of civilians digging something out of the ground, they notice the civilians are digging a mind flayer. When they are spotted by the mind flayer, the civilians turn on the players and fight. The players killed the mind flayer and the civilians.
They get out of the ship and meet Gale. Who seemed to have just teleported here using a teleportation circle. They notice Gale is infected like them and he points them into the direction of chapel ruins where artifacts are hidden. He tells them that he will meet them again soon and hopes they can share in the hidden treasures of the chapel ruins and that they will be on friendly terms.
Players make their way to the ruins to find Shadowheart trying to enter through the front door but finding it locked and not able to open it. She asks if they’ve seen an artifact lying around. Makir showed it to her. She compelled it to come back to her, but found out that it had attuned to the players. After having a difficult interaction with the players, she tells them to bring The Artifact to Baldur’s Gate. And that she will be waiting for them there.
By doing a dc 10 Religion check, players notice Shadowheart wears the symbol of the goddess of Shar.
Shar is the Faerûnian goddess of darkness and night, the malevolent twin counterpart to the goddess of the moon, Selûne. (pour André – Shar took pleasure in corrupting Aasimar in various ways to mainly create discord in their ranks).
Players then decided to go up the side of the cliff to find bandits looting around the upper part of the chapel. After an encounter, the players rid the place of the bandits on the outside. Eldil and Aeson left them during the night. Eldil was feeling torn by more important things; he grew out his Aasimar wings and flew away. Aeson left without talking much, just saying his objectives didn’t seem to align with those of the group.
Players enter the chapel the next day to find more bandits inside. They fight and kill them.
They then solve a puzzle leading back to the lower levels of the chapel through a secret corridor.
They find a room with skeletons in it and signs of battle. After killing the risen skeletons, the players can examine the statue of Jergal in the middle of the room. They notice it's supposed to be holding a tome in its hands. Makir placed the tome which opened another secret door.
In that room was the most beautiful and ornate sarcophagus the players had ever seen. The sarcophagus opened by itself and out came a high priest of Jergal. The high priest informs the players of Jergal’s history and tells them their paths will cross again later, because their destinies will impact the things that are to come. He also gifted the players of his treasures.
Jergal : was originally the god of Death. Is now the lord of the end of everything. He grew wary of his throne. Hence he decided to gift its empty powers to the dead three (Murder, Tyranny and Death). Balg used to be an assassin and a charmer. He took over the portfolio of Murders. Bane used to be a warrior and a tyrant. He took over the portfolio of tyranny. Finally, Myrkul used to be a necromancer. He took over the portfolio of death.

Bow attacks the hobgoblin from his window and hit once and crits on the other.
Grimgil casts hold person and burns a legendary resistance on the hobgoblin.
Blorg succeeds his grovel save
Jaden hits the hobgoblin twice
Owl helps Blorg attack the hobgoblin
Eldil attacks the hobgoblin hits once, bardic inspires Grimgil

The party loots the Hobgoblin. He has a leather armor and a great axe with a weird eye symbol on it and an Oath Bow. Afterwards Blorg grabs Dror Ragzlin and throws him over the inner city wall exclaiming praise to Maglubiyet.
The party heads to the west for the barracks where Dryz is being held, doing so stealthily enough to avoid being detected. Blorg informs the party that Minthara is in the town hall where the prisons are. he also informs them that it would be better to sneak through the barracks. Arcane eyes are used to monitor and surveil the barracks and town hall.
Blorg sends his owl into the barracks to cause a distraction and bring people's attention away from the town hall. Grimgil investigates the town hall basement during the distraction and see's a makeshift prison with wooden cells. He sees Dryz unconscious in the basement and also see's a goblin guard in the basement. Bow investigates the town hall main level and gets instantly spotted by Arcane Eye. Eldil enters the town hall basement through a window and gets a surprise round on the guard and grapples him. Blorg enters activates Maglubiyet's might and breaks open the prison bars to Dryz's cell. Jaden enters and kills the goblin guard. Grimgil gives a goodberry to Dryz and revives him.
The party runs away and attempts to escape via the sewers. Blorg casts alarm on the sewer grate. Grimgil uses his smell to find the best direction to travel down the sewers and find an exit outside of Celadon. They manage to escape and return to the forest outside the city. Halsin's location remains a mystery
Blorg informs the party that one of the prisoners was a shapeshifting druid that shipped to Trixie. the Goblin's capital city to participate in gladiator type games for Da Bawss, the Goblin King. The games are called The Goblin's Arena. Trixie is to the west.
Minthara is planning a strike on Sylvanus Grove and will start mobilizing in the next few days. it will probably occur in 6 days. it is a similar distance to go to Trixie the party need to decide where to go.
The party decides to destroy the goblin army in Celadon directly. Blorg decides to head to Trixie to show them Maglubiyet's might.
